steps.text: Go down into the Minotaur Pyramid north-east of Darashia (minotaurs).
steps.source: Head to the Minotaur Pyramid north-east of Darashia. You will only have to face Minotaurs on the ground level. Go down the staircase.

steps.text: Minotaurs and minotaur guards: follow the path south-west and go down.
steps.source: Down these steps you will face Minotaurs and one or two Minotaur Guards. Follow this path to the south-west, and go down another staircase.

steps.text: Head east (minotaur guards, minotaur archers) and go down.
steps.source: Head to the East/North-East. There will be several Minotaur Guards and Minotaur Archers on this floor. There will be another staircase to go down.

steps.text: All kinds of minotaurs, minotaur mages too: head north and go down.
steps.source: On the next level are all kinds of Minotaurs, including about 4 Minotaur Mages. On this level, head North. Look for another staircase down.
Down this staircase, you will face one Mummy.

steps.text: The south-east coffin: the stealth ring.
steps.source: After killing the Mummy, the Stealth Ring can be found in the south-east coffin

steps.text: The north-east coffin: the protection amulet.
steps.source: and the Protection Amulet can be found in the north-east coffin.
